name: Losing Weight
overview: Scripture encourages self-discipline and reliance on the Lord's strength in the pursuit of physical well-being, as seen in Proverbs 23:21, which warns against gluttony leading to poverty and weakness. Isaiah 40:31 reminds believers that those who wait upon the Lord will have renewed strength to endure and persevere without fainting. The example of Daniel (Daniel 1:11) illustrates faithfulness in stewardship over one's body, while Jesus’ teachings in Matthew 7:7 and Mark 11:23 affirm the power of persistent faith to overcome challenges. Ultimately, John 16:33 offers peace and encouragement to remain steadfast, trusting that Christ has overcome the world, including the struggles that accompany personal growth and discipline.
